about: What RockyGPT cannot read on Ramapo's sites, and why. Reviewed by hand (the robots.txt part is also checked automatically every night: data/review/blocked-pages.md). A source moves off this list only when the site itself allows it.

sources.what: Banner Self-Service class search: class sections, open seats, meeting times, rooms and instructors
sources.detail: Its robots.txt refuses every robot for the whole site (checked 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-18).
sources.effect: The bot cannot say which sections are open, when a class meets or who teaches a section. It points students to the class search.
None: events come from the groups' calendar files and Archway's public events list instead.

sources.what: Files clubs post on Archway (/upload/, /student_docs/, /downloads/) and its widget pages (ajax_widget_new)
sources.effect: Flyers and documents clubs upload are not read.

sources.what: Events Archway shows only to signed-in students (sign-in or registration required)
sources.detail: The public events list hides their names and places; RockyGPT never signs in (about 15 events on 2026-11-05).
sources.effect: The bot knows such an event exists but not its name or place.

sources.what: The athletics site's feeds and files: /services/ (schedule feeds, text schedules), /documents/ (PDF guides), print views, /images/, /common/, /site/, /hidden/
sources.detail: Disallowed for every robot by its robots.txt, which also asks for 30 seconds between pages (2026-11-03).
sources.effect: Team schedules are read from each team's schedule page, one page every 30 seconds, about 8 minutes a night.

sources.detail: The only path ramapo.edu's robots.txt disallows (2026-11-18).

sources.site: Student-only systems (the Ramapo portal, Canvas, student email, student records)
sources.what: Anything behind a student's own sign-in: grades, schedules, bills, financial aid status
sources.detail: RockyGPT reads only public pages and never signs in as anyone.
sources.effect: The bot cannot answer about one student's own records. It says where to look.
